text:

author: Heather_R

title: Horse show lovely
text:
Camella and Gwen tour guides were great.Enjoyed the winery but sherry very different to what we tasted before and only liked 1.
Horse show was just lovely and well worth the  extra payment. Cadiz beautiful but forgot to pack for the beach.
author: juliavzz

title: Would recommend the horse...
text: Would recommend the horse show with the sherry tasting tickets.  The horse show was absolutely beautiful and an event that should.be seen.
author: Sandra_B

title: Show
text: Enchanting presentation, tuning between the horses and their horsemen and amazons, pleasant Mood.
author: Katia_V

title: Sweet Jerex
text: It was a great trip. Our guide Daniella was terrific. She spoke clearly and provided important basic information at every step. She ensured we were well coordinated. It was an enjoyable day.
author: 570alvins

title: Jerez and Cadiz tour
text: Andrea was a great guide!  She gave us a lot of great information and history of the area.  The bus ride to Jerez and Cadiz was a long one.  But the sherry tasting and the Spanish riding school were worth the trip.
author: DanF590

title: Great day trip from Seville
text: Great trip, well organized and our guide Carlos did a great job of translating between English and Spanish.  The Sherry tasting Jerez was great, horses amazing and a nice stop for lunch and exploration in Cadiz.  The air conditioned bus was a nice treat for the quick ride back to Seville at the end of the day.
author: Mary_G

title: Great day trip
text: Really enjoyed this tour, sherry tasting was a perfect start, followed by a wonderful horse show and ending in beautiful Cádiz, perfect day trip out.
author: David_N

title: Wonderful day in Spain
text: The sherry was wonderful and the horses were excellent we had a great time didn't know how good sherry could be.  Learned alot about sherry
author: cynthiawP1128NX

title: Excellent day!
text: Best trip!   Manuel Bottazzo is a great guide; personable, professional, knowledgeable plus a fun sense of humour.  Nothing disappointed - everything about this trip is superb!
author: lorettaclark
